entities.summary: Аlexandr Abramovich Drouz is a veteran contestant of the Russian TV gameshow What? Where? When?, first of the currently five "Magisters of the Game"; Vice-president of the International Association of Clubs What? When?, director of the Saint-Petersburg branch of the What? When?
